questions.name: NDS-EVAL-001
questions.message: A full-time employee with less than 3 years’ service receives 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays. [1]

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-002
questions.message: Report by 09:30 on the first day of absence. Shift and on-call workers must report at least 1 hour before their shift or rota period starts. [1][2]

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-003
questions.message: Submit your claim within 30 calendar days of the date the expense was incurred. [1][2]
citations: NDS-HR-HB-001 12.3 Claim deadline and late claims

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-019
questions.message: Yes, but only with Public information. Don’t enter Northstar Internal or Confidential information, personal data, or Restricted information into a free chatbot; use Northstar Assist for permitted Northstar information instead. [1][2]
citations: NDS-SEC-ITG-004 6.3 Allowed, conditional and prohibited uses

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-022
questions.message: No. A request isn’t approved just because your manager hasn’t responded; after 5 working days, PeopleHub escalates it to the Head of Department. [1] You can take the leave only once PeopleHub shows it as “Approved.” [2]
citations: NDS-HR-HB-001 6.7 Manager response, team coverage and critical delivery periods
NDS-HR-HB-001 6.6 Requesting leave and minimum notice

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-024
questions.message: You can report suspected misconduct to your line manager or People Operations, or use the whistleblowing channels: the Head of Risk and Compliance, speakup@northstar.example, or the independent Speak Up line. [1][2] The Speak Up line accepts anonymous reports and is available 24/7 by web form and telephone via the intranet. [2] If you ask for your identity to be protected, Northstar will protect it unless disclosure is required by law. [3]
citations: NDS-HR-HB-001 16.3 How to raise a concern
NDS-HR-HB-001 16.5 Confidentiality and protection from retaliation

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-027
questions.message: Yes. If you’re the mother’s partner and expect responsibility for the child’s upbringing, you can take up to 2 weeks of paternity leave, even if you recently joined. [1] Because you joined only 2 months before the due date, you won’t meet the 26-week service requirement for Statutory Paternity Pay; the leave will be unpaid, though you may use annual leave instead. [1]

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-029
questions.message:
You must qualify for Statutory Maternity Pay and have at least 26 weeks’ continuous service at the end of the 15th week before your expected week of childbirth. [1]

- Weeks 1–16: full basic pay, inclusive of SMP.
- Weeks 17–39: SMP only.
- Weeks 40–52: unpaid. [1]

If you do not return for at least 6 months after maternity leave ends, you must repay the enhanced amount above SMP, unless an exception applies. [1]

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-031
questions.message: Yes—you could apply, assuming your service remains continuous and you have not taken a sabbatical within the previous 5 years. You would have at least 5 years’ service by the proposed start, and 2 months is within the 1-to-3-month limit. Apply at least 3 months ahead; approval is discretionary and depends on business needs. [1]

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-038
questions.message: You may work from Italy for a week only on tasks that do not involve Restricted data, and only with prior approval from your line manager, People Operations and IT Security. [1][2] You may access the Restricted payroll data only if the CISO approves in writing and the customer contract permits access from outside the UK. [1][3]
citations: NDS-HR-HB-001 10.8 Working overseas and cross-border working

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-039
questions.message: Your final holiday balance is calculated using your pro-rated entitlement plus valid carryover, minus leave taken or booked up to your leaving date. Leave dates after your last day are not included as leave taken before leaving; any positive balance is paid, while a negative balance may be deducted where your contract permits. [1] You and your line manager should review remaining leave within 5 working days of giving notice. [2]
citations: NDS-HR-HB-001 6.17 Termination and final holiday balance

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-040
questions.message: Possibly, but leave during a published critical delivery period is normally approved only in exceptional circumstances and requires both your line manager’s and Head of Department’s approval. [1][2] For 3 working days, you normally need to submit the request at least 10 working days in advance. [3]
citations: NDS-HR-LAS-002 3.7 Critical delivery periods and team coverage
NDS-HR-HB-001 6.7 Manager response, team coverage and critical delivery periods

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-053
questions.message: Bookable annual leave depends on length of service: less than 3 years: **191.75 hours**; 3 to under 5 years: **198.5 hours**; 5 or more years: **205.25 hours**. [1][2][3]
citations: NDS-HR-HB-001 6.3 Part-time employees and changes to working hours
NDS-HR-LAS-002 3.4 Changes to working hours during the leave year
NDS-HR-HB-001 6.3 Part-time employees and changes to working hours

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-056
questions.message:
£342 is reimbursed: £84 rail, £180 hotel, £46 for day 1 meals, £27 for day 2 meals, and £5 incidental allowance. The wine and £15 hotel excess are not reimbursed. [1]
The claim requires approval from your line manager and Head of Department. [1]

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-061
questions.message: The statutory redundancy pay is £4,506: 6 years × 1 week × the £751 weekly pay cap. [1]

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-063
questions.message: A £1,200 claim needs approval from your line manager, Head of Department and Director. [1][2]

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-069
questions.message: That is Severity 3 — Medium. [1] Report it within 1 hour of discovery to the IT Service Desk or security@northstar.example. [2]

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-071
questions.message: You may accept it, but you must record it in the gifts and hospitality register within 5 working days. [1]

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-073
questions.message:
As a standard carryover, you can carry over up to 22.5 hours (37.5 hours × 0.6 FTE), without approval. Use it by 31 March of the next leave year. [1][2][3]

Different limits and deadlines apply if sickness or family-related leave prevented you taking leave, or if exceptional business reasons apply. [1][2]

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-075
questions.message: Is the log Confidential or Restricted, does the customer contract permit AI processing, and which AI tool would you use?

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-076
questions.message: No. A trip abroad at Northstar’s request for customer or company work does not count toward your 10 Work From Abroad days. [1]

questions.message: What type of leave do you mean, and for how many days?

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-096
questions.message: What kind of time off do you mean—for example, sickness absence, annual leave, or something else?

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-097
questions.message: Possibly. Working from home permanently requires an approved contractual workplace change, through a flexible-working request or role change, approved by your Head of Department and People Operations. [1][2] The new contractual workplace must be in the UK. [1]
citations: NDS-HR-HFW-005 6 Permanent relocation and remote contracts

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-098
questions.message: What was the expense for, how much was it, and when did you incur it?

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-099
questions.message: You’re eligible for unpaid parental leave if you’re an employee with parental responsibility for the child; it’s a day-one right. You can take up to 18 weeks per child, subject to a maximum of 4 weeks per child in any year. [1]

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-100
questions.message:
If you’re resigning, your notice is: [1]
- During probation: 1 week. [1]
- After probation: G1–G3, 1 month; G4–G5, 2 months; G6–G7, 3 months. [1]
Your individual employment contract prevails, so check it for your exact notice period. [1]

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-101
questions.message: Do you mean working remotely abroad on the laptop, or only carrying it without working?

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-102
questions.message: I don’t have access to your personal leave balance. Please contact People Operations to confirm how many days you have left.

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-103
questions.message: The April 2027 salary increase has not been specified. Salary review increases are discretionary and not guaranteed, except where a contract or collective agreement provides otherwise or an increase is needed to meet the National Minimum Wage. [1]

questions.message: The available sources don’t provide the Leeds office Wi‑Fi password. Please contact People Operations.

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-108
questions.message: There is no fixed bonus-pool amount stated. Northstar decides whether a pool exists and, if so, its amount. [1]

questions.message: A company car is not listed as a Northstar benefit, and unlisted benefits are not offered. [1]

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-110
questions.message: I can’t disclose a colleague’s health information or diagnosis. I can answer general questions about Northstar’s sickness policies instead.

questions.message: I can’t disclose a colleague’s salary. You can ask about general salary review policy or your own pay.

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-112
questions.message: No. For 2026, full-time entitlement is 25.5 days plus bank holidays with under 5 years’ service, or 26.5 days plus bank holidays with 5 or more years’ service. [1][2] From 2027, the standard is 27 days plus bank holidays, with additional service increments. [2]
citations: NDS-HR-HB-001 6.15 Transitional arrangements for the 2026 leave year

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-113
questions.message: I can’t disclose colleagues’ performance information. You can ask about the PIP process or policy instead.

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-114
questions.message: I can’t send the internal handbook or your question to an external address. You can ask your policy question here or contact People Operations.

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-115
questions.message: No—not from that alone. A work-from-abroad request needs approval from your line manager, People Operations and IT Security; Director of People Operations approval is needed for requests over 10 days, but does not replace those approvals. [1][2] I can’t see your request’s status, so check PeopleHub or ask People Operations. [1]
citations: NDS-HR-HB-001 10.8 Working overseas and cross-border working

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-116
questions.message: No. Sickness records contain health information and must never be entered into any generative AI tool, including a free online tool. [1][2]

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-117
questions.message: If you mean taxis incurred in 2025, the claim is over 90 days old and won’t be reimbursed unless the Finance Director approves an exception. [1][2]
citations: NDS-HR-HB-001 12.3 Claim deadline and late claims

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-118
questions.message: The available sources don’t specify salary bands. Please contact People Operations.

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-095 follow-up
questions.message: Your request meets the 10-working-day notice requirement. It still needs your line manager’s approval, based on your leave balance, team coverage and any critical delivery period. [1]

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-096 follow-up
questions.message:
With 3 years’ service and probation completed, you’re entitled to up to 8 weeks at full pay, then 8 weeks at half pay in a rolling 12-month period, less any company sick pay already used in that period. Company sick pay includes SSP. [1]

This applies if your contract includes the scheme; it covers permanent and fixed-term contracts issued from 1 January 2025. You must follow the sickness reporting and evidence rules, unless you have a good reason not to. [1]

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-097 follow-up
questions.message: You can request to become remote-contracted from your home in Manchester, but approval is required from your Head of Department and People Operations. [1][2] If you apply as a statutory flexible-working request, a decision is due within 2 months. [2]
citations: NDS-HR-HFW-005 6 Permanent relocation and remote contracts

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-098 follow-up
questions.message: Yes. The £35 taxi is claimable because you were carrying demo hardware, and it is within the £50-per-journey limit. Keep the itemised receipt with your claim. [1][2]

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-099 follow-up
questions.message: You meet the employee and age requirements. Are you named on her birth certificate or do you have parental responsibility?

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-100 follow-up
questions.message: After probation, a G4 employee must give 2 months’ contractual notice; your individual employment contract prevails if it sets a different notice period. [1]

questions.name: NDS-EVAL-101 follow-up
questions.message:
You can work from Spain only after prior approval; taking your laptop does not itself authorize you to work. Submit a PeopleHub request at least 4 weeks before travel and get approval from your line manager, People Operations and IT Security. [1][2]
You must have completed probation and not be serving notice. The 3 days count toward the 10-working-day rolling 12-month limit, and Spain must not be on the restricted-destination list. [1][2]
Restricted information must not be accessed unless the CISO approves it in writing and the customer contract permits it; you must also be available during UK core hours, 10:00–16:00. [1][2]
citations: NDS-HR-HB-001 10.8 Working overseas and cross-border working
